coverage.summary: Applies to any person furnishing rental accommodations, credit or services. Subsection 10 states no unit-count or owner-occupancy exemption.

evidence.quoted_span: For any person furnishing credit, services or rental accommodations to discriminate against any individual who is a recipient of federal, state, or local public assistance
For any person furnishing credit, services or rental accommodations to discriminate against any individual who is a recipient of federal, state, or local public assistance

result.notes: Removed other_conditions. It described the protected class (public-assistance and housing-subsidy recipients), which is a tenant characteristic, not a condition on buildings, units or owners. Set requires_unknown_facts to false because subsection 10 reaches anyone furnishing rental accommodations, not a special class of subsidized buildings. Subsection 10 itself states no exemptions. The two-family owner-occupied exemptions appear only in subsections 7 and 11 and were not imported, so unverifiable_exemptions is empty. The summary's second sentence is a statement about what the text omits, so no quote can show it directly; the quote above supports only the first sentence.
